description: Large language models produce text from learned patterns. Learn tokens, context, next-token choices and evidence checks through small examples with clearly stated limits. This introductory course uses small examples and short practice tasks. Read the lessons in order, check the result, and try one change. Finishing these lessons gives you a starting point for further study.
versionNote: Introductory examples. Read the setup note before using a separate tool.
whatYouWillLearn: Explain tokens are pieces of text
Explain a vocabulary gives pieces ids
Explain embeddings turn ids into vectors
Explain context is the text available now

seo.title: Language Models Tutorial for Beginners
seo.description: Learn Large Language Models with clear steps, small examples and practice questions. Explore the basics at your own pace, then check what you learned.
